text:
Sofia: Quick FYI — I'm about to change RBAC for the key-provisioner service account to support ephemeral grants for private KMS agents. Goal: reduce long-lived grant exposure and make backups/snapshots use short-lived CMEK leases. :eyes:
AJ: Nice. Do we have the audit log fields we need to tie a snapshot->grant? I want cmek_id + grant_id + grant_ttl in logs.
Sofia: Not yet. I'll add an audit enrichment that writes encryption.cmek_key_id and encryption.kms_grant_id to object-store and db snapshot logs.
Kevin: Any compatibility concerns with the vendor backup agent? Last week their agent was reusing grants indefinitely.
Mira: That's the vuln I raised. Vendor returns grant tokens that don't expire unless you call revoke. We should force TTL on our side and rotate grants every 15m.
Sofia: Agreed. Plan: 1) Update IAM role binding to remove broad kms:Decrypt from the uploader long-lived SA 2) Introduce grant broker that issues 15m grants per upload 3) Patch vendor agent config to fetch per-run grant and drop it after upload.
AJ: Can you paste the IAM diff you'll apply? I want to run asap in staging.
Sofia: Sure — will apply this policy patch in staging first:
```
- members: - serviceAccount:backup-uploader@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
  role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
+ members: - serviceAccount:key-provisioner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
  role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
+ condition: { title: "short-lived-grants", expression: "request.time < timestamp(request.time + duration('15m'))" }
```
Mira: Note: GCP conditions above are illustrative; we'll implement TTL via the grant broker not IAM condition (GCP condition syntax is tricky).
encops-bot: [alert] Detected 3 snapshot uploads in prod with grant_ttl > 24h last 72h — created encops/long_grant_grep-3601
ops_oncall: Will we need a runbook update? If audit logs change, SRE alert rules might need new fields.
Sofia: Yes — I'll update runbooks: backup-restore-playbook, snapshot-audit-runbook. Also will add a quick kql to query for missing encryption.cmek_key_id.
Kevin: For verification — I'll run an end-to-end test: create test snapshot, upload with brokered grant, confirm CloudAudit logs include encryption.cmek_key_id and kms.grant_id and that grant expires after 15m.
AJ: If test passes, roll to prod after a 48h canary. Keep me tagged.
Mira: Also let's ensure KMS provider rotation is documented. If we switch to HSM-backed keys, logs must still include key fingerprints.
Sofia: Agreed. I'll open a follow-up PR for provider rotation doc and link it here once ready. Thanks all. :rocket:
